parameters.name: super5
parameters.label: Super5 algorithm (-super5)
parameters.help_text: Faster algorithm for large datasets (>1000 sequences).

parameters.name: threads
parameters.label: Threads (-threads)
parameters.help_text: Number of CPU cores to use.

parameters.name: perm
parameters.label: Guide tree permutation (-perm)
parameters.help_text: Permute the guide tree before alignment. Changes the alignment outcome; useful for sensitivity analysis.

parameters.name: perturb
parameters.label: Perturbation seed (-perturb)
parameters.help_text: Random perturbation seed for guide tree (0 = no perturbation).

parameters.name: consiters
parameters.label: Consistency iterations (-consiters)
parameters.help_text: Number of consistency iterations. Higher values improve accuracy but increase runtime. Default 2.

parameters.name: refineiters
parameters.label: Refinement iterations (-refineiters)
parameters.help_text: Number of refinement iterations. Higher values may improve accuracy. Default 100.
